mcqs.question: Following South Coast Railway becoming the 18th railway zone, how many stars were incorporated into the new Indian Railways logo, with each star representing one zone?
mcqs.explanation: The new Indian Railways logo has 18 stars, with one star representing each railway zone after South Coast Railway became the 18th zone. The figure 99.6% refers to Broad Gauge electrification, while 25,000 and 1,670 relate to trains per day and freight handled, respectively.
